The go/no-go rule can approve both message-led theories on the same absolute thresholds and does not require a head-to-head result that separates them.

The proposed 15% intent and €20 stated-WTP cutoffs are assumptions, not evidence that a consumer coating would sell profitably; treating their attainment as sufficient to develop the proposition overstates what the test would show.

judgment.screen_reason: The episode is complete, but its test decision rule does not discriminate the rival theories, and its conditional investment recommendation exceeds what the proposed observations could establish.
